zones.name: Budshead
zones.text: Devon & Cornwall Police recorded 348 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 8.8 per 1,000 residents, the 9th highest rate of Plymouth's 20 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (8), drugs (2), vehicle crime (2); the evening/night score by violent crime (60), public order (9), anti social behaviour (8). Those two scores are split by offence type, not by clock time — the police feed records no time of day, so day and night here mean the kinds of crime typical of each, not counts of incidents observed then. Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.
